text.p: Ameriwood Industries International Corp said chief financial officer Craig Wassenaar resigned.
Wassenaar plans to go to work for Family Bookstores Co Inc, a national chain of 188 stores that sell Christian books and related materials, Ameriwood said.

The manufacturer of unassembled furniture, branded speakers and other custom-built products said that Wassenaar's duties will be assumed temporarily by president and chief executive Charles Foley, who was previously vice president of finance. Foley was named president and CEO in January.
Ameriwood said a search is underway to replace Wassenaar, who will remain at Ameriwood until June 23.
"Craig expressed that Family Bookstores offered him a unique opportunity to blend his business skills with a ministry-focused company, and we wish him the best," Foley said.
